_readme: Curation layer for extraction/notebook_raw.json (the Pages notebook 'Dutch A1/A2').
Keys are '<date>||<raw nl cell>'. Each value may set: nl, en, pos, article, lemma,
infinitive, drop (true = leave the entry out), and why (free text, for the audit trail).
The raw file is a verbatim dump of the .pages tables and inline notes, so it keeps the
spelling exactly as typed in the notebook; this file is where it gets corrected.
parse_notebook.py applies these on top of the raw dump.
